thread:
Maya Patel: Quick design review — we moved rotate/revoke into the row overflow to declutter the list, but a few PMs and engs reported rotate is now harder to discover. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/keys-list (see 'Row actions' frame)
Sam Liu: I think rotate is a high-frequency action for infra teams. Overflow makes sense for 'transfer' or 'audit', but rotate/copy should be 1-click.
Lee Gardner: Accessibility concern: putting primary actions only in an overflow menu adds extra keyboard and VO navigation. Current focus order is: row -> overflow button -> menu -> item. That's 2 extra interactions per rotate. We should expose rotate as an icon button with aria-label="Rotate key" and visible focus state. :keyboard:
Olivia Chen: Copy suggestion for rotate modal header: change 'Rotate API Key' to 'Rotate credential' to keep consistent terminology. Also tweak the warning copy from 'This will replace the key' to 'The old key will stop working immediately — update any running services.'
Eliot (design): Proposed compromise: inline show 2 small action icons on hover/always-on-hover for desktop: 'Rotate' (circular arrow) and 'Copy secret' (clipboard). Put dangerous actions like 'Revoke' and 'Transfer' in overflow. On mobile keep single overflow to save space. I'll mock this.
Maya Patel: +1. Also thinking about a 'pin' affordance so teams can pin frequently-rotated keys to the top or a starred view. Would help discovery for power users.
Sam Liu: a11y-bot flagged tooltip contrast and missing focus ring on icon buttons. Current tooltip color (~#9aa0a6) fails AA at 12px — need 4.5:1.
a11y-bot: Automated scan: tooltip text contrast ratio 3.8:1 (FAIL). Icon button focus outline missing on focused state (FAIL). Recommendation: increase tooltip text contrast or use a solid dark bg, and implement a 3px visible outline or use a 2px box-shadow for focus.
Olivia Chen: Microcopy for ephemeral view: current text 'This secret will only be shown once. Store it now.' Suggest stronger phrasing: 'Shown once. Store safely — this secret cannot be recovered.' Add a small copy link 'How to store secrets securely' to docs.
Lee Gardner: Keyboard behaviour: If focus lands on inline rotate button, Enter should trigger rotate, Escape should close any confirmation, and tab order must remain predictable. Ensure buttons have role="button" and clear aria-labels. Consider aria-describedby for the confirmation text.
Maya Patel: For the empty state, propose a primary CTA 'Create credential' and a tiny inline CLI snippet to reduce time-to-hello:
```bash
redwood credentials create --name my-service --scopes embeddings,generate
```
Plus 1-sentence on scopes and least-privilege, and a link to 'temporary keys' docs. Also add a small hint: 'Temporary keys expire after 24h' with an info icon.
Sam Liu: Bulk revoke UX nit: current modal says 'Are you sure?' which is too vague. Change to: 'Revoke 12 keys? This will immediately invalidate them — affected services may break.' Add checkbox 'I understand services may be interrupted' and show an 'Undo for 30s' snackbar after action.
Olivia Chen: I'll update the Figma file with inline rotate + updated copy and contrast fixes, and run a quick 5-person usability pass focusing on discovery and keyboard flows.
Maya Patel: Thanks! tagging @Lee Gardner to validate keyboard interactions after the Figma update. :thumbsup:
